result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-round payment processor**, but if you're using Shopify, I'd generally recommend **Shopify Payments** instead.

If you're operating in Australia, there are a few particularly good options worth comparing.

## My top 5 payment processors

![Stripe Logo Download (SVG, PNG, EPS, PDF) | PixelBrands](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aVtuLxJXV9DmtEmg9b45Apl_aIYsif99dM-GHSfkXYZDC4tFOhFvFlTrHocFw_PqD4iGlfn8TyGj8Knz3iEfgQ88Gl1qbf-qVS8yq3s_dga8IuVvdS85dQWTHuxQAfDBHQSn4bvLAWea6XSgqDlmrU-sz5LlptntGZmOFqqabVil8_uydbbIqAvaqwgrj-k8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Excellent for online-only stores.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce, Wix and other platforms.
- Supports subscriptions, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Australian domestic cards: approximately 1.65% + A\$0.30.

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout and payment management.
- Supports major cards and digital wallets.
- Australian Basic plan online card rate: approximately 1.75% + A\$0.30.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Airwallex**

(Best for international sales)

- Competitive Australian domestic processing fees.
- Excellent multi-currency capabilities.
- Useful for businesses selling overseas.
- Domestic cards: approximately 1.65% + A\$0.30.

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

- Widely recognised by online shoppers.
- Customers can pay using their PayPal accounts.
- Useful as an additional checkout option.
- Generally higher transaction fees than Stripe.

[PayPal Business Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![Square, Inc Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/o-iRI2kybznmyDubdZ44gVK-vjE6gDKLVakQnJxlACGxko3Nj1jIpWaBRdIuWDcPvStz6IZe1O-k-UExmpEW7lDQ_S559qV-l4JT0xhrWDjCbTjdZDVgBDFR6LW32FKPeauHAWGYSuEdhn0AMiHDAZFaPUNLlmIzwiGcOc7OZzuhVnlNs80uSa8gb9GbKVsf?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Square**

- Great if you sell online and in person.
- Integrates payments and point-of-sale systems.
- Useful for retailers, markets and small shops.

[Square Australia](https://squareup.com/au/en)

Indicative Australian pricing based on published comparisons for 2026. Actual rates depend on card type, payment method, plan and transaction circumstances. ## What I'd choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a small online store | Stripe |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Selling internationally | Airwallex |
| Want customers to pay with PayPal | Add PayPal |
| Selling online and in person | Square |
